===== script probe28_inner.py =====
import ldap, os, time
from ldap.controls import LDAPControl
U='ldap://127.0.0.1:3389'; S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-36,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S
dmpw=os.environ['DMPW']
def conn(dn=None,pw=None):
  c=ldap.initialize(U); c.protocol_version=3; c.set_option(ldap.OPT_REFERRALS,0)
  if dn: c.simple_bind_s(dn,pw)
  return c
dm=conn('cn=Directory Manager',dmpw)
def who(s): return f'uid={s},{P}'
def pwd(s): return f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1'
def rc(f):
  try: f(); return 0
  except ldap.LDAPError as e:
    d=e.args[0] if e.args else {}
    return d.get('result', -1)
for dn,ou in [(P,'people'),(B,'probe-36')]:
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[ou.encode()])])
dm.add_s(who('m_uid'),[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[b'm_uid']),('cn',[b'm']),('sn',[b'S']),('userPassword',[pwd('m_uid').encode()])])
dm.modify_s(B,[(ldap.MOD_ADD,'aci',[f'(target="ldap:///{B}")(targetattr="uid")(version 3.0; acl "p28"; allow (write) userdn="ldap:///{who("m_uid")}";)'.encode()])])
dm.modify_s(B,[(ldap.MOD_ADD,'aci',[f'(target="ldap:///{B}")(targetattr="*")(version 3.0; acl "p28r"; allow (read,search,compare) userdn="ldap:///anyone";)'.encode()])])
def mk(uid):
  dn=f'uid={uid},{B}'; rc(lambda: dm.delete_s(dn))
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[uid.encode()]),('cn',[b'c']),('sn',[b'S'])]); return dn
def show(base):
  try:
    r=dm.search_s(B,ldap.SCOPE_ONELEVEL,'(uid=*)',['uid','modifyTimestamp','modifiersName'])
    return [(d,{k:[v.decode() for v in vs] for k,vs in a.items()}) for d,a in r if base.lower() in d.lower()]
  except ldap.LDAPError as e: return 'ERR'
print('== no-op and case-only renames ==')
for who_,c in [('dm',dm),('m_uid',conn(who('m_uid'),pwd('m_uid')))]:
  for label,uid,newrdn,sup,dold in [('noop_sup_del0','nop0','uid=nop0'+'',B,0),('noop_sup_del1','nop1','uid=nop1',B,1),('noop_nosup_del1','nop2','uid=nop2',None,1),
                                    ('case_del1','casea','uid=CASEA',None,1),('case_del0','caseb','uid=CASEB',None,0)]:
    u=uid+who_.replace('_','')
    nr=newrdn.replace(uid,u).replace(uid.upper(),u.upper())
    dn=mk(u); before=show(u); time.sleep(1.1)
    r=rc(lambda: c.rename_s(dn,nr,sup,dold))
    after=show(u)
    print(f'{who_:6} {label:16} rc={r} before={before} after={after}')
    rc(lambda: dm.delete_s(dn)); rc(lambda: dm.delete_s(f'{nr},{B}'))
print('== anonymous ordering ==')
mk('o_a'); mk('o_b')
an=conn()
print('anon missing', rc(lambda: an.rename_s('uid=ghost,'+B,'uid=ghost2',None,1)))
print('anon onto_existing', rc(lambda: an.rename_s('uid=o_a,'+B,'uid=o_b',None,1)))
print('anon into_self', rc(lambda: an.rename_s(B,'ou=probe-36','uid=o_a,'+B,0)))
print('anon plain', rc(lambda: an.rename_s('uid=o_a,'+B,'uid=o_c',None,1)))
print('== absolute filter vs critical control ==')
unk=LDAPControl('1.3.6.1.4.1.99999.1',True,None)
for flt in ['(&)','(uid=o_a)']:
  try: r=dm.search_ext_s(B,ldap.SCOPE_ONELEVEL,flt,['1.1'],serverctrls=[unk]); out='rc=0'
  except ldap.LDAPError as e: d=e.args[0]; out=f"rc={d.get('result')} {d.get('desc')} {d.get('info','')}"
  print('crit-unknown', flt, out)
print('== unknown RDN type as DM ==')
print('dm bad_newrdn_attr', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=o_a,'+B,'nosuchattr=x',None,0)))
print('dm bad_newrdn_attr del1', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=o_a,'+B,'nosuchattr=x',None,1)))

===== script probe29.py =====
# Oracle probe 29: unknown RDN type on a fresh entry (does a 65 commit?), (&) vs invalid base DN and bad paged cookie.
# DSL multi-element targetattr lists. Runs a throwaway pinned 389 container; inner script uses python-ldap.
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, sys
ref=open(sys.argv[1]).read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-probe29-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix','dc=example,dc=test','--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix'],capture_output=True,text=True); print('backend',r.returncode)
  sp.run(['docker','cp','probe29_inner.py',n+':/tmp/p.py'],check=True)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec','-e','DMPW='+pw,n,'python3','/tmp/p.py'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr[-3000:])
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script probe29_inner.py =====
import ldap, os
from ldap.controls import SimplePagedResultsControl
U='ldap://127.0.0.1:3389'; S='dc=example,dc=test'; B='ou=probe-36,'+S
dm=ldap.initialize(U); dm.protocol_version=3; dm.simple_bind_s('cn=Directory Manager',os.environ['DMPW'])
dm.add_s(B,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[b'probe-36'])])
def mk(u):
  dn=f'uid={u},{B}'; dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[u.encode()]),('cn',[b'c']),('sn',[b'S'])]); return dn
def rc(f):
  try: f(); return 0
  except ldap.LDAPError as e: return e.args[0].get('result')
def listing(): return sorted(d for d,_ in dm.search_s(B,ldap.SCOPE_ONELEVEL,'(objectClass=*)',['1.1']))
for dold in (0,1):
  dn=mk(f'bad{dold}')
  print(f'del{dold} rc={rc(lambda: dm.rename_s(dn,"nosuchattr=x",None,dold))} after={listing()}')
  rc(lambda: dm.delete_s(dn)); rc(lambda: dm.delete_s('nosuchattr=x,'+B))
print('after cleanup', listing())
for base,flt in [('not a dn','(&)'),('not a dn','(objectClass=*)'),('uid=ghost,'+B,'(&)'),('uid=ghost,'+B,'(objectClass=*)')]:
  try: dm.search_s(base,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,flt,['1.1']); out='rc=0'
  except ldap.LDAPError as e: d=e.args[0]; out=f"rc={d.get('result')} {d.get('info','')}"
  print('base',repr(base),flt,out)
for flt in ['(&)','(objectClass=*)']:
  c=SimplePagedResultsControl(True,size=10,cookie=b'garbage-cookie')
  try: dm.search_ext_s(B,ldap.SCOPE_ONELEVEL,flt,['1.1'],serverctrls=[c]); out='rc=0'
  except ldap.LDAPError as e: d=e.args[0]; out=f"rc={d.get('result')} {d.get('info','')}"
  print('badcookie',flt,out)

===== script probe30.py =====
# Oracle probe 30: moddn right semantics (CAND-39) and case-only rename (CAND-30).
# DSL multi-element targetattr lists. Runs a throwaway pinned 389 container; inner script uses python-ldap.
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, sys
ref=open(sys.argv[1]).read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-probe30-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix','dc=example,dc=test','--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix'],capture_output=True,text=True); print('backend',r.returncode)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'dsconf','localhost','config','replace','nsslapd-dynamic-plugins=on'],capture_output=True,text=True); print('dynplugins',r.returncode)
  for plug in ['referential-integrity','memberof']:
    r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'dsconf','localhost','plugin',plug,'enable'],capture_output=True,text=True); print('plugin',plug,r.returncode)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'dsconf','localhost','config','get','nsslapd-moddn-aci'],capture_output=True,text=True); print(r.stdout.strip())
  time.sleep(3)
  sp.run(['docker','cp','probe30_inner.py',n+':/tmp/p.py'],check=True)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec','-e','DMPW='+pw,n,'python3','/tmp/p.py'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr[-3000:])
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script probe30_inner.py =====
import ldap, os, time
U='ldap://127.0.0.1:3389'; S='dc=example,dc=test'
B='ou=src,'+S; D='ou=dst,'+S; E='ou=other,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S; G='ou=groups,'+S; X='ou=subjects,'+S
dmpw=os.environ['DMPW']
def conn(dn=None,pw=None):
  c=ldap.initialize(U); c.protocol_version=3; c.set_option(ldap.OPT_REFERRALS,0)
  if dn: c.simple_bind_s(dn,pw)
  return c
dm=conn('cn=Directory Manager',dmpw)
def who(s): return f'uid={s},{X}'
def pwd(s): return f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1'
def rc(f):
  try: f(); return 0, ''
  except ldap.LDAPError as e:
    d=e.args[0] if e.args else {}
    return d.get('result', -1), (d.get('desc','')+' '+d.get('info','')).strip()[:100]
for dn,ou in [(X,'subjects'),(P,'people'),(B,'src'),(D,'dst'),(E,'other'),(G,'groups')]:
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[ou.encode()])])
def T(b): return f'(target="ldap:///{b}")'
WU=(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="uid || ou")','write')
A={
 'plain_S':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn')],
 'plain_S_ta_notaci':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr!="aci")','moddn')],
 'plain_S_ta_cn':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="cn")','moddn')],
 'plain_B':[WU,(B,T(B),'moddn')],
 'plain_D':[WU,(D,T(D),'moddn')],
 'plain_BD':[WU,(B,T(B),'moddn'),(D,T(D),'moddn')],
 'tf_only':[WU,(S,f'(target_from="ldap:///{B}")','moddn')],
 'tt_only':[WU,(S,f'(target_to="ldap:///{D}")','moddn')],
 'tf_tt':[WU,(S,f'(target_from="ldap:///{B}")(target_to="ldap:///{D}")','moddn')],
 'tf_tt_rev':[WU,(S,f'(target_from="ldap:///{D}")(target_to="ldap:///{B}")','moddn')],
 'tf_tt_kids':[WU,(S,f'(target_from="ldap:///uid=*,{B}")(target_to="ldap:///{D}")','moddn')],
 'S_deny_add_D':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(D,T(D),'DENYadd')],
 'S_deny_del_B':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(B,T(B),'DENYdelete')],
 'S_deny_moddn_D':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(D,T(D),'DENYmoddn')],
 'S_deny_moddn_B':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(B,T(B),'DENYmoddn')],
 'S_deny_write_B':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(B,T(B),'DENYwrite')],
 'S_deny_write_D':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(D,T(D),'DENYwrite')],
 'S_nowrite':[(S,T(S),'moddn')],
 'S_writecn':[(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="cn")','write'),(S,T(S),'moddn')],
 'S_addD':[WU,(D,T(D),'add')],
 'rt_PG':[(P,T(P)+'(targetattr!="aci")','add,delete,write,read,search,compare,moddn'),(G,T(G)+'(targetattr!="aci")','add,delete,write,read,search,compare,moddn'),(S,T(S)+'(targetattr!="userPassword")','read,search,compare')],
 'rt_P':[(P,T(P)+'(targetattr!="aci")','add,delete,write,read,search,compare,moddn'),(S,T(S)+'(targetattr!="userPassword")','read,search,compare')],
 'w_uid':[WU],
}
for s in A:
  dm.add_s(who(s),[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[s.encode()]),('cn',[s.encode()]),('sn',[b'S']),('userPassword',[pwd(s).encode()])])
for s,lst in A.items():
  for k,(base,ta,perm) in enumerate(lst):
    act='deny ('+perm[4:]+')' if perm.startswith('DENY') else 'allow ('+perm+')'
    t=f'{ta}(version 3.0; acl "p30:{s}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s)}";)'
    r=rc(lambda: dm.modify_s(base,[(ldap.MOD_ADD,'aci',[t.encode()])]))
    if r[0]: print('aci',s,k,r)
n=[0]
def mkent(base,uid=None):
  n[0]+=1; uid=uid or f'e{n[0]}'
  dn=f'uid={uid},{base}'
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[uid.encode()]),('cn',[uid.encode()]),('sn',[b'S'])])
  return dn,uid
def mv(s,dn,newrdn,sup,dold):
  c=conn(who(s),pwd(s)); r=rc(lambda: c.rename_s(dn,newrdn,sup,dold)); c.unbind_s(); return r
print('== moves B->D (same rdn, del0) | B->D rename uid del1 | B->E | B->B/sub | D->B | missing superior ==')
dm.add_s('ou=sub,'+B,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[b'sub'])])
for s in A:
  if s.startswith('rt_'): continue
  out=[]
  dn,u=mkent(B); out.append('BD=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',D,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); out.append('BDren=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}r',D,1)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); out.append('BDcn=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'cn={u}c',D,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); out.append('BE=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',E,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); out.append('Bsub=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}','ou=sub,'+B,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(D); out.append('DB=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',B,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); out.append('nosup=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}','ou=nope,'+S,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); out.append('ghost=%s'%mv(s,f'uid=ghost{n[0]},{B}',f'uid=ghost{n[0]}',D,0)[0])
  print(f'{s:20}',' '.join(out))
print('== runtime-like ==')
dm.add_s('ou=team,'+P,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[b'team'])])
for s in ['rt_PG','rt_P']:
  out=[]
  dn,u=mkent(P); out.append('PG=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',G,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(G); out.append('GP=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',P,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(P); out.append('Pteam=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}','ou=team,'+P,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(P); out.append('PB=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',B,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); out.append('BP=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',P,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(P); out.append('Pren=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}r',None,1)[0])
  print(f'{s:20}',' '.join(out))
print('== subtree move ==')
for s in ['plain_S','tf_tt',None]:
  ou=f'ou=tree{n[0]},{B}'; n[0]+=1
  dm.add_s(ou,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[ou.split(',')[0][3:].encode()])])
  kid,_=mkent(ou)
  if s: r=mv(s,ou,ou.split(',')[0],D,0)
  else: r=rc(lambda: dm.rename_s(ou,ou.split(',')[0],D,0))
  newkid=kid.replace(B,D)
  ok=rc(lambda: dm.search_s(newkid,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['1.1']))[0]
  print(s or 'DM', 'subtree move', r, 'kid at new place rc', ok)
print('== case-only rename (CAND-30) ==')
grp='cn=team,'+G
dm.add_s(grp,[('objectClass',[b'groupOfNames']),('cn',[b'team']),('member',[b'uid=keeper,'+B.encode()])])
dm.add_s('uid=keeper,'+B,[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[b'keeper',b'keeper-alt']),('cn',[b'k']),('sn',[b'S'])])
def show(dn):
  r=dm.search_s(dn,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['uid','modifyTimestamp','memberOf','entrydn'])
  return r[0][0], {k:[v.decode() for v in vs] for k,vs in r[0][1].items()}
print('before', show('uid=keeper,'+B))
time.sleep(1.1)
print('dm del0', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=keeper,'+B,'uid=Keeper',None,0)), show('uid=keeper,'+B))
print('group', dm.search_s(grp,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['member'])[0][1])
print('dm del1', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=Keeper,'+B,'uid=KEEPER',None,1)), show('uid=keeper,'+B))
print('group', dm.search_s(grp,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['member'])[0][1])
print('dm parentcase', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=keeper,OU=SRC,DC=EXAMPLE,dc=test','uid=Keeper',None,1)), show('uid=keeper,'+B))
print('dm same spelling', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=Keeper,'+B,'uid=Keeper',None,1)), show('uid=keeper,'+B))
# non-root
for s in ['w_uid','S_writecn','S_deny_write_B','plain_S']:
  dn,u=mkent(B, f'case{s.replace("_","")}')
  r=mv(s,dn,f'uid={u.upper()}',None,1)
  print('nonroot case-only',s,r[0], show(dn)[0])
# case-only + move
dn,u=mkent(B,'casemove')
r=mv('plain_S',dn,'uid=CASEMOVE',D,1); print('case+move plain_S',r[0])
r=rc(lambda: dm.search_s('uid=casemove,'+D,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['uid'])); print('after', r)
print(dm.search_s('uid=casemove,'+D,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['uid']))

===== script probe31_inner.py =====
import ldap, os, time
U='ldap://127.0.0.1:3389'; S='dc=example,dc=test'
B='ou=src,'+S; D='ou=dst,'+S; E='ou=other,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S; G='ou=groups,'+S; X='ou=subjects,'+S
dmpw=os.environ['DMPW']
def conn(dn=None,pw=None):
  c=ldap.initialize(U); c.protocol_version=3; c.set_option(ldap.OPT_REFERRALS,0)
  if dn: c.simple_bind_s(dn,pw)
  return c
dm=conn('cn=Directory Manager',dmpw)
def who(s): return f'uid={s},{X}'
def pwd(s): return f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1'
def rc(f):
  try: f(); return 0, ''
  except ldap.LDAPError as e:
    d=e.args[0] if e.args else {}
    return d.get('result', -1), (d.get('desc','')+' '+d.get('info','')).strip()[:100]
for dn,ou in [(X,'subjects'),(P,'people'),(B,'src'),(D,'dst'),(E,'other'),(G,'groups')]:
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[ou.encode()])])
def T(b): return f'(target="ldap:///{b}")'
WU=(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="uid || ou")','write')
WC=(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="cn || uid || ou")','write')
A={
 'm_S':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn')],
 'm_S_tacn':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="cn")','moddn')],
 'm_S_tauid':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="uid")','moddn')],
 'm_S_tacn_wc':[WC,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="cn")','moddn')],
 'm_B':[WU,(B,T(B),'moddn')],
 'm_D':[WU,(D,T(D),'moddn')],
 'none':[WU],
 'denyM_B':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(B,T(B),'DENYmoddn')],
 'denyM_S':[WU,(S,T(S),'DENYmoddn')],
 'readonly':[(S,T(S),'read,search')],
}
for s in A:
  dm.add_s(who(s),[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[s.encode()]),('cn',[s.encode()]),('sn',[b'S']),('userPassword',[pwd(s).encode()])])
for s,lst in A.items():
  for k,(base,ta,perm) in enumerate(lst):
    act='deny ('+perm[4:]+')' if perm.startswith('DENY') else 'allow ('+perm+')'
    t=f'{ta}(version 3.0; acl "p31:{s}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s)}";)'
    r=rc(lambda: dm.modify_s(base,[(ldap.MOD_ADD,'aci',[t.encode()])]))
    if r[0]: print('aci',s,k,r)
n=[0]
def mkent(base,uid=None):
  n[0]+=1; uid=uid or f'e{n[0]}'
  dn=f'uid={uid},{base}'
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[uid.encode()]),('cn',[uid.encode()]),('sn',[b'S'])])
  return dn,uid
def mv(s,dn,newrdn,sup,dold):
  c=conn(who(s),pwd(s)); r=rc(lambda: c.rename_s(dn,newrdn,sup,dold)); c.unbind_s(); return r
dm.add_s('uid=taken,'+D,[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[b'taken']),('cn',[b'taken']),('sn',[b'S'])])
print('cols: gRen=ghost same-parent rename | gMv=ghost move B->D | gMvCn=ghost cn= move | gMvE=ghost move B->E | nosupS=real B->ou=nope,S | nosupD=real B->ou=nope,D | ren=real same-parent rename | renSup=rename w/ explicit same sup | taken=move onto existing DN in D | self=move under itself')
for s in A:
  o=[]
  n[0]+=1; o.append('gRen=%s'%mv(s,f'uid=g{n[0]},{B}',f'uid=g{n[0]}r',None,0)[0])
  n[0]+=1; o.append('gMv=%s'%mv(s,f'uid=g{n[0]},{B}',f'uid=g{n[0]}',D,0)[0])
  n[0]+=1; o.append('gMvCn=%s'%mv(s,f'cn=g{n[0]},{B}',f'cn=g{n[0]}',D,0)[0])
  n[0]+=1; o.append('gMvE=%s'%mv(s,f'uid=g{n[0]},{B}',f'uid=g{n[0]}',E,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('nosupS=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}','ou=nope,'+S,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('nosupD=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}','ou=nope,'+D,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('ren=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}r',None,1)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('renSup=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}r',B,1)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('taken=%s'%mv(s,dn,'uid=taken',D,1)[0])
  ou=f'ou=t{n[0]},{B}'; dm.add_s(ou,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[f't{n[0]}'.encode()])])
  o.append('self=%s'%mv(s,ou,ou.split(',')[0],ou,0)[0])
  print(f'{s:14}',' '.join(o))
print('== case-only subtree (DM) ==')
dm.add_s('ou=tree,'+B,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[b'tree'])])
mkent('ou=tree,'+B,'kid')
print('rename', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('ou=tree,'+B,'ou=TREE',None,1)))
for dn,a in dm.search_s(B,ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE,'(|(ou=tree)(uid=kid))',['ou','uid','entrydn']): print(' ',dn,{k:[v.decode() for v in vs] for k,vs in a.items()})
print('== case-only with explicit newSuperior respelled (m_S, none) ==')
for s in ['m_S','none','denyM_B','denyM_S']:
  dn,u=mkent(B,'co'+s.replace('_','').lower())
  r=mv(s,dn,f'uid={u.upper()}','OU=SRC,'+S,1)
  print(s, r[0], dm.search_s(B,ldap.SCOPE_ONELEVEL,f'(uid={u})',['uid'])[0])
print('== case-only, non-root, deleteoldrdn 0 ==')
dn,u=mkent(B,'cozero'); print('m_S del0', mv('m_S',dn,'uid=CoZero',None,0)[0], dm.search_s(B,ldap.SCOPE_ONELEVEL,'(uid=cozero)',['uid'])[0])
print('== case-only of a group (memberOf on member) ==')
mkent(P,'mem')
dm.add_s('cn=crew,'+G,[('objectClass',[b'groupOfNames']),('cn',[b'crew']),('member',[b'uid=mem,'+P.encode()])])
print('rename', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('cn=crew,'+G,'cn=Crew',None,1)))
time.sleep(1)
print(' member memberOf', dm.search_s('uid=mem,'+P,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['memberOf'])[0][1])
print('== move of a group member (refint) ==')
mkent(P,'mover')
dm.modify_s('cn=crew,'+G,[(ldap.MOD_ADD,'member',[b'uid=mover,'+P.encode()])])
print('move', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=mover,'+P,'uid=mover',G,0)))
time.sleep(2)
print(' group', dm.search_s('cn=crew,'+G,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['member'])[0][1])
print(' memberOf', dm.search_s('uid=mover,'+G,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['memberOf'])[0][1])

===== script probe32.py =====
# Oracle probe 30: moddn right semantics (CAND-39) and case-only rename (CAND-30).
# DSL multi-element targetattr lists. Runs a throwaway pinned 389 container; inner script uses python-ldap.
import subprocess as sp, time, secrets, sys
ref=open(sys.argv[1]).read().strip()
pw=secrets.token_hex(16); n='muse-probe32-'+secrets.token_hex(3)
sp.run(['docker','run','-d','--name',n,'-e','DS_DM_PASSWORD='+pw,'-v','/data',ref],stdout=sp.DEVNULL,check=True)
try:
  for i in range(600):
    l=sp.run(['docker','logs',n],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if '389-ds-container started.' in l.stdout+l.stderr: break
    time.sleep(0.5)
  print('image',ref)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'dsconf','localhost','backend','create','--suffix','dc=example,dc=test','--be-name','userroot','--create-suffix'],capture_output=True,text=True); print('backend',r.returncode)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'dsconf','localhost','config','replace','nsslapd-dynamic-plugins=on'],capture_output=True,text=True); print('dynplugins',r.returncode)
  for plug in ['referential-integrity','memberof']:
    r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'dsconf','localhost','plugin',plug,'enable'],capture_output=True,text=True); print('plugin',plug,r.returncode)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec',n,'dsconf','localhost','config','get','nsslapd-moddn-aci'],capture_output=True,text=True); print(r.stdout.strip())
  time.sleep(3)
  sp.run(['docker','cp','probe32_inner.py',n+':/tmp/p.py'],check=True)
  r=sp.run(['docker','exec','-e','DMPW='+pw,n,'python3','/tmp/p.py'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr[-3000:])
finally:
  sp.run(['docker','rm','-f','-v',n],capture_output=True)

===== script probe32_inner.py =====
import ldap, os, time
U='ldap://127.0.0.1:3389'; S='dc=example,dc=test'
B='ou=src,'+S; D='ou=dst,'+S; E='ou=other,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S; G='ou=groups,'+S; X='ou=subjects,'+S
dmpw=os.environ['DMPW']
def conn(dn=None,pw=None):
  c=ldap.initialize(U); c.protocol_version=3; c.set_option(ldap.OPT_REFERRALS,0)
  if dn: c.simple_bind_s(dn,pw)
  return c
dm=conn('cn=Directory Manager',dmpw)
def who(s): return f'uid={s},{X}'
def pwd(s): return f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1'
def rc(f):
  try: f(); return 0, ''
  except ldap.LDAPError as e:
    d=e.args[0] if e.args else {}
    return d.get('result', -1), (d.get('desc','')+' '+d.get('info','')).strip()[:100]
for dn,ou in [(X,'subjects'),(P,'people'),(B,'src'),(D,'dst'),(E,'other'),(G,'groups')]:
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[ou.encode()])])
def T(b): return f'(target="ldap:///{b}")'
WU=(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="uid || ou")','write')
WC=(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="cn || uid || ou")','write')
A={
 'm_S_nowrite':[(S,T(S),'moddn')],
 'm_S_denywB':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(B,T(B),'DENYwrite')],
 'm_S_writecn':[(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="cn")','write'),(S,T(S),'moddn')],
 'm_S_tastar':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="*")','moddn')],
 'm_S_tanotstar':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr!="*")','moddn')],
 'm_S_tanotuid':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr!="uid")','moddn')],
 'm_S_tastaruid':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="* || uid")','moddn')],
 'm_S_ta_uidcn':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr!="uid || cn || ou || objectClass || entrydn")','moddn')],
}
for s in A:
  dm.add_s(who(s),[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[s.encode()]),('cn',[s.encode()]),('sn',[b'S']),('userPassword',[pwd(s).encode()])])
for s,lst in A.items():
  for k,(base,ta,perm) in enumerate(lst):
    act='deny ('+perm[4:]+')' if perm.startswith('DENY') else 'allow ('+perm+')'
    t=f'{ta}(version 3.0; acl "p32:{s}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s)}";)'
    r=rc(lambda: dm.modify_s(base,[(ldap.MOD_ADD,'aci',[t.encode()])]))
    if r[0]: print('aci',s,k,r)
n=[0]
def mkent(base,uid=None):
  n[0]+=1; uid=uid or f'e{n[0]}'
  dn=f'uid={uid},{base}'
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[uid.encode()]),('cn',[uid.encode()]),('sn',[b'S'])])
  return dn,uid
def mv(s,dn,newrdn,sup,dold):
  c=conn(who(s),pwd(s)); r=rc(lambda: c.rename_s(dn,newrdn,sup,dold)); c.unbind_s(); return r
dm.add_s('uid=taken,'+D,[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[b'taken']),('cn',[b'taken']),('sn',[b'S'])])
print('cols: gRen=ghost same-parent rename | gMv=ghost move B->D | gMvCn=ghost cn= move | gMvE=ghost move B->E | nosupS=real B->ou=nope,S | nosupD=real B->ou=nope,D | ren=real same-parent rename | renSup=rename w/ explicit same sup | taken=move onto existing DN in D | self=move under itself')
for s in A:
  o=[]
  n[0]+=1; o.append('gRen=%s'%mv(s,f'uid=g{n[0]},{B}',f'uid=g{n[0]}r',None,0)[0])
  n[0]+=1; o.append('gMv=%s'%mv(s,f'uid=g{n[0]},{B}',f'uid=g{n[0]}',D,0)[0])
  n[0]+=1; o.append('gMvCn=%s'%mv(s,f'cn=g{n[0]},{B}',f'cn=g{n[0]}',D,0)[0])
  n[0]+=1; o.append('gMvE=%s'%mv(s,f'uid=g{n[0]},{B}',f'uid=g{n[0]}',E,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('nosupS=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}','ou=nope,'+S,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('nosupD=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}','ou=nope,'+D,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('ren=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}r',None,1)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('renSup=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}r',B,1)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('taken=%s'%mv(s,dn,'uid=taken',D,1)[0])
  ou=f'ou=t{n[0]},{B}'; dm.add_s(ou,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[f't{n[0]}'.encode()])])
  o.append('self=%s'%mv(s,ou,ou.split(',')[0],ou,0)[0])
  print(f'{s:14}',' '.join(o))

  return c

def pwd(s): return f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1'

  except ldap.LDAPError as e:
    d=e.args[0] if e.args else {}
    return d.get('result', -1), (d.get('desc','')+' '+d.get('info','')).strip()[:100]

  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[ou.encode()])])
def T(b): return f'(target="ldap:///{b}")'
WU=(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="uid || ou")','write')
WC=(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="cn || uid || ou")','write')
A={
 'm_S_tanotstar':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr!="*")','moddn')],
 'm_S_tauid':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="uid")','moddn')],
 'm_S_tanotuid':[WU,(S,T(S)+'(targetattr!="uid")','moddn')],
 'm_S_denyta':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(D,T(D)+'(targetattr="uid")','DENYmoddn')],
 'm_S_denynotstar':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(D,T(D)+'(targetattr!="*")','DENYmoddn')],
 'm_newdn':[WU,(S,'(target="ldap:///uid=exact,'+D+'")','moddn')],
 'm_S':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn')],
}
for s in A:
  dm.add_s(who(s),[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[s.encode()]),('cn',[s.encode()]),('sn',[b'S']),('userPassword',[pwd(s).encode()])])

  for k,(base,ta,perm) in enumerate(lst):
    act='deny ('+perm[4:]+')' if perm.startswith('DENY') else 'allow ('+perm+')'

    if r[0]: print('aci',s,k,r)

  n[0]+=1; uid=uid or f'e{n[0]}'
  dn=f'uid={uid},{base}'

  return dn,uid
def mv(s,dn,newrdn,sup,dold):
  c=conn(who(s),pwd(s)); r=rc(lambda: c.rename_s(dn,newrdn,sup,dold)); c.unbind_s(); return r
for s in A:
  o=[]
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('BD=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',D,0)[0])
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('exact=%s'%mv(s,dn,'uid=exact',D,1)[0])
  dm.add_s('ou=k%d,'%n[0]+D,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[b'k%d'%n[0]])])
  sub='ou=k%d,'%n[0]+D
  dn,u=mkent(B); o.append('Dsub=%s'%mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',sub,0)[0])
  print(f'{s:16}',' '.join(o))
print('== spelling ==')
def sp(label,dn,newrdn,sup):
  r=rc(lambda: dm.rename_s(dn,newrdn,sup,1))
  print(label,r[0],[d for d,_ in dm.search_s(S,ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE,'('+newrdn+')',['1.1'])])
dn,u=mkent(B,'sa'); sp('rename explicit sup respelled','uid=sa,'+B,'uid=sa2','OU=SRC,'+S)
dn,u=mkent(B,'sb'); sp('rename src respelled no sup','uid=sb,OU=SRC,'+S,'uid=sb2',None)
dn,u=mkent(B,'sc'); sp('rename src respelled + sup lower','uid=sc,OU=SRC,'+S,'uid=sc2',B)
dn,u=mkent(B,'sd'); sp('move sup respelled','uid=sd,'+B,'uid=sd','OU=DST,'+S)
print('== memberOf after case-only rename of member ==')
mkent(P,'mm')
dm.add_s('cn=grp,'+G,[('objectClass',[b'groupOfNames']),('cn',[b'grp']),('member',[b'uid=mm,'+P.encode()])])
print(rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=mm,'+P,'uid=MM',None,1)))
time.sleep(1)
print(dm.search_s('cn=grp,'+G,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['member'])[0][1], dm.search_s('uid=mm,'+P,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['memberOf'])[0])

===== script probe34_inner.py =====
import ldap, os, time
U='ldap://127.0.0.1:3389'; S='dc=example,dc=test'
B='ou=src,'+S; D='ou=dst,'+S; E='ou=other,'+S; P='ou=people,'+S; G='ou=groups,'+S; X='ou=subjects,'+S
dmpw=os.environ['DMPW']
def conn(dn=None,pw=None):
  c=ldap.initialize(U); c.protocol_version=3; c.set_option(ldap.OPT_REFERRALS,0)
  if dn: c.simple_bind_s(dn,pw)
  return c
dm=conn('cn=Directory Manager',dmpw)
def who(s): return f'uid={s},{X}'
def pwd(s): return f'Probe-Pw-{s}-1'
def rc(f):
  try: f(); return 0, ''
  except ldap.LDAPError as e:
    d=e.args[0] if e.args else {}
    return d.get('result', -1), (d.get('desc','')+' '+d.get('info','')).strip()[:100]
for dn,ou in [(X,'subjects'),(P,'people'),(B,'src'),(D,'dst'),(E,'other'),(G,'groups')]:
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[ou.encode()])])
def T(b): return f'(target="ldap:///{b}")'
WU=(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="uid || ou")','write')
WC=(S,T(S)+'(targetattr="cn || uid || ou")','write')
N='dc=example,dc=net'; NB='ou=far,'+N
dm.add_s(NB,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[b'far'])])
A={
 'm_both':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(N,T(N),'moddn'),(N,T(N)+'(targetattr="uid || ou")','write')],
 'm_S':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn')],
 'newdn':[WU,(S,'(target="ldap:///uid=exactZ,'+D+'")','moddn')],
 'w_src':[(B,T(B)+'(targetattr="uid || ou")','write'),(S,T(S),'moddn')],
 'w_dst':[(D,T(D)+'(targetattr="uid || ou")','write'),(S,T(S),'moddn')],
 'denyw_dst_uid':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(D,T(D)+'(targetattr="uid")','DENYwrite')],
 'denyw_src_uid':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(B,T(B)+'(targetattr="uid")','DENYwrite')],
 'denyM_B_uid':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(B,T(B)+'(targetattr="uid")','DENYmoddn')],
 'denyM_B_ns':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(B,T(B)+'(targetattr!="*")','DENYmoddn')],
 'denyM_B_star':[WU,(S,T(S),'moddn'),(B,T(B)+'(targetattr="*")','DENYmoddn')],
}
for s in A:
  dm.add_s(who(s),[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[s.encode()]),('cn',[s.encode()]),('sn',[b'S']),('userPassword',[pwd(s).encode()])])
for s,lst in A.items():
  for k,(base,ta,perm) in enumerate(lst):
    act='deny ('+perm[4:]+')' if perm.startswith('DENY') else 'allow ('+perm+')'
    t=f'{ta}(version 3.0; acl "p34:{s}-{k}"; {act} userdn="ldap:///{who(s)}";)'
    r=rc(lambda: dm.modify_s(base,[(ldap.MOD_ADD,'aci',[t.encode()])]))
    if r[0]: print('aci',s,k,r)
n=[0]
def mkent(base,uid=None):
  n[0]+=1; uid=uid or f'e{n[0]}'
  dn=f'uid={uid},{base}'
  dm.add_s(dn,[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[uid.encode()]),('cn',[uid.encode()]),('sn',[b'S'])])
  return dn,uid
def mv(s,dn,newrdn,sup,dold):
  c=conn(who(s),pwd(s)); r=rc(lambda: c.rename_s(dn,newrdn,sup,dold)); c.unbind_s(); return r
print('== cross-backend ==')
dn,u=mkent(B); print('DM S->N', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s(dn,f'uid={u}',NB,0)))
dn,u=mkent(NB); print('DM N->S', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s(dn,f'uid={u}',D,0)))
dn,u=mkent(B); print('m_both S->N', mv('m_both',dn,f'uid={u}',NB,0))
dn,u=mkent(NB); print('m_both N->S', mv('m_both',dn,f'uid={u}',D,0))
print('DM ghost S->N', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=ghostx,'+B,'uid=ghostx',NB,0)))
print('m_both ghost S->N', mv('m_both','uid=ghosty,'+B,'uid=ghosty',NB,0))
dn,u=mkent(B); print('m_both S->N missing sup', mv('m_both',dn,f'uid={u}','ou=nope,'+N,0))
dn,u=mkent(B); print('m_S S->N', mv('m_S',dn,f'uid={u}',NB,0))
print('== gates ==')
for s in ['newdn','w_src','w_dst','denyw_dst_uid','denyw_src_uid']:
  dn,u=mkent(B); a=mv(s,dn,'uid=exactZ' if s=='newdn' else f'uid={u}',D,1 if s=='newdn' else 0)[0]
  dn,u=mkent(B); b=mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}r',D,1)[0]
  print(f'{s:16} BD={a} BDren={b}')
print('== existence with targeted denies ==')
for s in ['denyM_B_uid','denyM_B_ns','denyM_B_star']:
  n[0]+=1; g=mv(s,f'uid=g{n[0]},{B}',f'uid=g{n[0]}',D,0)[0]
  dn,u=mkent(B); real=mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',D,0)[0]
  dn,u=mkent(D); intoB=mv(s,dn,f'uid={u}',B,0)[0]
  print(f'{s:16} ghostInB={g} realBD={real} DB={intoB}')
print('== group move: memberOf ==')
mkent(P,'gm1')
dm.add_s('cn=mob,'+P,[('objectClass',[b'groupOfNames']),('cn',[b'mob']),('member',[b'uid=gm1,'+P.encode()])])
print('move group', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('cn=mob,'+P,'cn=mob',G,0)))
time.sleep(2); print(' memberOf', dm.search_s('uid=gm1,'+P,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['memberOf'])[0][1])
print('== subtree move with group+member inside, and outside group ==')
T1='ou=unit,'+B
dm.add_s(T1,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[b'unit'])])
mkent(T1,'inner')
dm.add_s('cn=ingrp,'+T1,[('objectClass',[b'groupOfNames']),('cn',[b'ingrp']),('member',[b'uid=inner,'+T1.encode()])])
dm.add_s('cn=outgrp,'+G,[('objectClass',[b'groupOfNames']),('cn',[b'outgrp']),('member',[b'uid=inner,'+T1.encode()])])
print('move subtree', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s(T1,'ou=unit',D,0)))
time.sleep(3)
T2='ou=unit,'+D
print(' outgrp', dm.search_s('cn=outgrp,'+G,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['member'])[0][1])
print(' ingrp', dm.search_s('cn=ingrp,'+T2,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['member'])[0][1])
print(' inner memberOf', dm.search_s('uid=inner,'+T2,ldap.SCOPE_BASE,'(objectClass=*)',['memberOf'])[0][1])
print('== move under mixed-case stored superior ==')
dm.add_s('ou=MixCase,'+D,[('objectClass',[b'organizationalUnit']),('ou',[b'MixCase'])])
dn,u=mkent(B); print('move', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s(dn,f'uid={u}','ou=mixcase,'+D,0)), [d for d,_ in dm.search_s(D,ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE,f'(uid={u})',['1.1'])])
dn,u=mkent(B); print('move typeupper', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s(dn,f'UID={u}','OU=MIXCASE,'+D,0)), [d for d,_ in dm.search_s(D,ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE,f'(uid={u})',['1.1'])])
print('== same spelling no-op vs respell of parent ==')
dn,u=mkent(B,'nop')
print('rename via OU=SRC', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=nop,OU=SRC,'+S,'uid=nop',None,1)), [d for d,_ in dm.search_s(S,ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE,'(uid=nop)',['1.1'])])
print('rename back lower', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s('uid=nop,'+B,'uid=nop',None,1)), [d for d,_ in dm.search_s(S,ldap.SCOPE_SUBTREE,'(uid=nop)',['1.1'])])
print('== non-ASCII case-only ==')
v='\u00e9t\u00e9'
dm.add_s(f'uid={v},{B}'.encode().decode(),[('objectClass',[b'inetOrgPerson']),('uid',[v.encode()]),('cn',[b'x']),('sn',[b'S'])])
print('rename', rc(lambda: dm.rename_s(f'uid={v},{B}','uid=\u00c9T\u00c9',None,1)), [ (d,a) for d,a in dm.search_s(B,ldap.SCOPE_ONELEVEL,'(cn=x)',['uid'])])
